title: bheka.evidence.sealed.v1
description: Emitted by bheka-case when a new evidence row is created and sealed (HPKE-encrypted, written to S3, row inserted in PostgreSQL). Stream: EVIDENCE. Consumers: bheka-console (case evidence list), retention scheduler (internal to bheka-case). One event per evidence row.

tier.description: Visibility tier at which this evidence was collected.

content_type.description: MIME type of the encrypted payload.

key_version.description: Vault key version used to seal the DEK (CANON section 6).

hash_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the plaintext content before encryption. Used for integrity verification on view.
